verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows image, audio, or document input to Jev, and the docs never explicitly say the model is text-only. The only hints are indirect: the quickstart says to "paste any text as the state," pricing and context limits are in tokens, and the vendor's limitations page lists no modality constraint. Those hints imply text input but are not an honest scope statement, so neither branch of the story is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input
